samples.hypothesis: So what happened in the first half was that the truck came on a little late because the wagon brake was still down, and by the time we got it released the lighting had already moved on to the next look, which is why the whole shift looked messy from the front and why I want to run it again before we brake. When we get to the end of the song I am going to call the lights first and then the fly piece, and I need everyone on the deck to wait until the cloth is all the way and then you hear me say clear before anybody walks under it, because we came very close to someone standing in the wrong place last night.
